s1.syndrome_frame: A subacute to chronic presentation of a breast lump with associated axillary discomfort and migratory pain
salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Multiple hypoechoic masses with varying sizes and locations within the right breast on ultrasonography
key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Mobile lump palpated in the right breast
Breast ultrasonography revealed multiple hypoechoic masses
No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

raw.syndrome_frame: A subacute to chronic presentation of a breast lump with associated axillary discomfort and migratory pain
salient_findings: Mobile lump in the right breast
Migratory discomfort and pain in the right axilla and upper-outer quadrant
Multiple hypoechoic masses with varying sizes and locations within the right breast on ultrasonography
key_facts: No family history of breast cancer
Mobile lump palpated in the right breast
Breast ultrasonography revealed multiple hypoechoic masses
No obvious blood-flow signals detected within the lesions on color Doppler flow imaging

shortlist.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common type of breast cancer, consistent with ultrasonography findings of hypoechoic masses

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor that can present as a mobile lump, consistent with patient's symptoms

shortlist.label: Phyllodes tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Rare tumor that can present as a lump, consistent with ultrasonography findings of hypoechoic masses

shortlist.label: Fat necrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Can present as a lump or mass, consistent with patient's history of trauma or impure water consumption

shortlist.label: Granulomatous mastitis
shortlist.why_kept: Can present with migratory pain and lump, consistent with patient's symptoms and ultrasonography findings

raw.rationale: The presence of multiple hypoechoic masses with well-delineated contours and no obvious blood-flow signals on color Doppler flow imaging, along with a mobile lump palpated in the right breast, is consistent with fibroadenoma, a common benign breast tumor.

rejected.label: Invasive ductal carcinoma
rejected.why: The lack of family history and the presence of well-delineated masses make this less likely

rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
rejected.why: These tumors are typically larger and more rapidly growing than the masses described

rejected.label: Fat necrosis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and ultrasonography findings do not suggest trauma or fat necrosis

rejected.label: Granulomatous mastitis
rejected.why: The absence of symptoms such as skin retraction, nipple retraction, or erythema makes this diagnosis less likely
